title: o7.b1.selector/v0
description: The versioned selector contract. Selection is a pure deterministic function of (gold state, task, selector contract/version, budget). Observations carry task-INDEPENDENT `topics`; a task carries task-RELATIVE priority here. The two never mix: no global `importance` is permitted on an observation, and no observation id drives selection except through the explicitly justified, ratio-capped anchor escape hatch. The reference implementation is research/b1-context/tools/o7b1/selector.py, whose file digest is recorded alongside every projection so a result can be traced to the exact logic that produced it.

required_topics.description: Topics this task is about. Weight 2 in the score. Every required topic must be represented in the final selection or the projection is INVALID (validity.missing_required_topics).

preferred_topics.description: Useful context. Weight 1. Makes an observation relevant, but its absence is not a validity failure.

excluded_topics.description: Hard deny. Exclusion is applied BEFORE relevance and beats a required-topic match, so a task can deny a topic without enumerating what else matches.

required_kinds.description: Kinds this task cannot function without. Adds 1 to the score, and a kind with no selected representative makes the projection INVALID (validity.missing_required_kinds).

anchor_observation_ids.description: Escape hatch for genuinely id-specific needs. An anchor forces an ELIGIBLE observation in regardless of topic match; it can never resurrect an ineligible one. Each anchor requires a rationale, and if more than 34% of the selection matched ONLY by anchor the contract refuses the task outright — that would be an answer key rather than a selector.

anchor_rationale.description: observation_id -> why the topic vocabulary is insufficient for it. Required for every anchor.

topic_id.description: Must appear in the gold state's own closed `topic_vocabulary`. An unknown topic FAILS CLOSED rather than silently matching nothing.

order: 1. ELIGIBILITY (task-independent): status in {current, pending} AND authority != agent_claim. Ineligible observations can never be selected, whatever a task asks for.
2. EXCLUSION: any overlap with excluded_topics omits the observation, beating any required match.
3. RELEVANCE: the observation must share at least one topic with required_topics or preferred_topics, otherwise it is omitted with an explicit reason.
4. ANCHORS: justified anchors bypass step 3 only.
5. SCORE: 2*|topics ∩ required| + 1*|topics ∩ preferred| + 1 if kind ∈ required_kinds + 1 if anchored.
6. ORDER: (-score, fixed kind order, observation_id) — a total order, so output is byte-stable.
7. BUDGET: admit in that order until byte or record budget is reached; every rejection is reported with a budget reason.
fail_closed_on: topic id absent from the gold state's topic_vocabulary
missing `selectors` block (an absent selector is NOT read as 'select everything')
anchor naming an unknown or ineligible observation
anchor-only share of the selection above 34%
digest_binding: selector_id and selector_version identify the contract
selector_impl_digest is the sha256 of the reference implementation file
selectors_digest is the sha256 of this task's own canonicalized selector block
